titolo: Google Gemini becomes Official AI Assistant Partner for Golden State Warriors and Valkyries
descr: Google expands its Gemini partnership with Golden State, adding AI support for fans and franchise operations.
paragrafi: On November 24, 2026 Google announced an expanded partnership with the Golden State Warriors, the 2026 WNBA Champion Valkyries, and Chase Center.
The deal adds Gemini features to the game‑day experience, including interactive videoboard tools at Chase Center and digital fan services for remote viewers.
Behind the scenes the team will use Gemini to build custom AI agents for business and basketball operations, extending the tools the organization has used since 2019.
FreeLLMArena’s latest blind vote ranks Gemini 3.8 Flash as the top free chat model, while Gemini 4 Carbon leads the paid category.
perche: Fans gain more interactive content during games, while the franchise streamlines operations with AI agents. The strong rankings of Gemini models suggest free options are competitive, giving users a viable alternative to paid solutions.
titoloFonte: How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.
